lines.say: Your app crashed at three A-M.
By the time you woke up, it was already back. Nobody touched it.
lines.show: By the time you woke up, it was [already back.] Nobody touched it.

lines.say: With Docker alone, a crashed container stays dead until you restart it by hand.
lines.show: With Docker alone, a crashed container *stays dead* until you restart it [by hand.]

lines.say: Traffic doubles? More copies, by hand too.
lines.show: Traffic doubles? More copies, *by hand* too.

lines.say: Tell a robot what you want.
Like a thermostat: you set twenty-one degrees, and it keeps the room there.
lines.show: Like a *thermostat:* you set *21°,* and it [keeps the room there.]

lines.say: Keep three copies running. One crashes? A new one starts in seconds.
lines.show: Keep *3 copies* running. One crashes? A new one starts *in seconds.*

lines.say: Traffic spikes? It adds copies. Traffic drops? It removes them.
lines.show: Traffic spikes? It *adds copies.* Traffic drops? It *removes them.*

lines.say: New version? It swaps copies one at a time. No downtime.
lines.show: New version? It swaps copies *one at a time.* No *downtime.*

lines.say: So that three A-M crash? Fixed before you woke up.
lines.show: So that *3 AM crash?* Fixed [before you woke up.]

lines.say: Docker packs the box. Kubernetes runs the fleet.
lines.show: *Docker* packs the box. *Kubernetes* runs the fleet.

lines.say: Google built it, and every big cloud offers it.
lines.show: *Google* built it, and every big cloud offers it.

lines.say: New to containers? The Docker reel is on my profile.
lines.show: New to containers? The *Docker reel* is on my profile.

lines.say: Follow for the rest of the series.
lines.show: [Follow] for the rest of the series.
